label: Setting
description: One place in the story, from a single room to a whole world: what kind of place it is, what being there is like, why the story needs it and how it bears on the people in it. How the world works, and the sensory grain of the whole book, belong to other kinds.

fields.label: Kind of place
fields.help: What sort of place this is and where it sits in the story's world, in a phrase or two.

fields.label: Real or invented
fields.help: Whether this place exists outside the book and how far the story departs from it; facts you must check belong in a research note.

options.label: A real place as it is

fields.label: Size and extent
fields.help: How much ground this place covers, from a single room to a whole world, which decides what other places can sit inside it.

options.label: A country, a world or beyond

fields.label: Sensory signature
fields.help: What it is like to stand here: the sights, sounds, smells, temperatures and textures that mark this place out from any other.

fields.label: Layout and landmarks
fields.help: The rooms, routes, landmarks and distances a reader needs in order to follow characters moving through this place, one per item.

fields.label: Ways in and out
fields.help: How people enter and leave this place, what stands in their way, and who decides who may pass.

fields.label: Purpose in the story
fields.help: Why the story needs this particular place rather than another, and what would be lost if its scenes happened elsewhere.

fields.label: Share of the book
fields.help: How much of the book happens here compared with the story's other places.

scaleLabels.high: Home ground for most of the book

fields.label: Usual occupants
fields.help: The kinds of people found here on an ordinary day, and who would stand out as not belonging, one group per item.

fields.label: Pressure on characters
fields.help: How the place helps, hinders, tests or changes the people in it, and which of them it presses on hardest.

fields.label: Traces of the past
fields.help: Marks the past has left here that a character could see, touch or hear about; each past event itself belongs in a timeline entry.

fields.label: What it conceals
fields.help: What this place keeps from a newcomer: spaces, routes or truths that only long acquaintance or a deliberate search will uncover.

fields.label: Change across the book
fields.help: How this place is different by the end of the book from how it was at the start, and what brought the change about.

fields.label: How they fit together
fields.help: What each contributes to the other, and how the part sits within the whole.

fields.label: What sets them apart
fields.help: What one holds that the other lacks, so that the two never blur together.

fields.label: How they fit together
fields.help: What each contributes to the other, and how the part sits within the whole.

fields.label: What sets them apart
fields.help: What one holds that the other lacks, so that the two never blur together.

fields.label: Where they meet or part
fields.help: The point on which the two stand against each other: one question answered two ways.

fields.label: What the comparison reveals
fields.help: What a reader understands from setting the two side by side that neither shows alone.

fields.label: How it shows on the page
fields.help: Where and how the reader meets this link: in an action, an image, a setting or a choice.

fields.label: Why it matters
fields.help: What this link does for the book: the meaning, pressure or effect it carries.

fields.label: How it shows on the page
fields.help: Where and how the reader meets this link: in an action, an image, a setting or a choice.

fields.label: Why it matters
fields.help: What this link does for the book: the meaning, pressure or effect it carries.

fields.label: Part played
fields.help: What the one does in or for the other: who acts, who is acted upon, who only looks on.

fields.label: What it leaves behind
fields.help: What this involvement costs, wins or changes for either side once it is over.

fields.label: What holds it together
fields.help: Why this link exists: the need, duty, fear, belief or bargain that keeps it in place.

fields.label: What each side gives and gets
fields.help: What passes between the two because of this link, such as loyalty, protection, money, secrets or obedience.

fields.label: Where it strains
fields.help: The pressure that could break or turn this link, and what would follow if it gave way.

fields.label: How it changes
fields.help: Where this link stands at the start of the book and at its end, and what moves it.

fields.label: What is drawn from it
fields.help: Which facts, methods or details pass from the source into the book.

fields.label: Liberties taken
fields.help: Where the book departs from the source on purpose, and why.
